title: US Labour Market Nowcast

labels.method: Bank of England-style factor model on US labour indicators

latest.boe_text: Job gains have kept pace with the workforce, and the unemployment rate has changed little.

indicators.name: Nonfarm payrolls
indicators.notes: BLS establishment survey, level. The target: underlying growth is scaled to its 3m/3m growth.

indicators.name: Household survey employment
indicators.notes: Current Population Survey; with the labour force gives the unemployment rate.

indicators.name: Real average hourly earnings
indicators.notes: Average hourly earnings, private, deflated by CPI: the real-wage side of the demand/supply SVAR.

indicators.name: Initial jobless claims
indicators.notes: Weekly; monthly value is the month's last week. Loads negatively.

indicators.name: Conference Board labour differential
indicators.notes: Jobs 'plentiful' minus 'hard to get' (consumer confidence survey); proprietary.
